reviews.text: TX pools delivered greatly on the installation of our pool. We encountered many positives during this process. They were helpful, as well as professional. Everything was done in a timely manner. The process was smooth and seamless and I would highly recommend them for all your pool installation needs. Donna Naras helped a great deal answering questions   And checking on the process for me, as well. If you’re looking at installing a fiberglass pool, reach out to them for any questions, concerns,

Huge shoutout to Donna for hooking us up with an incredible deal! TX Pools got everything installed super quickly, and the pool looks amazing! Donna has gone above and beyond to make sure every detail was taken care of, and the whole team has been fantastic to work with. If you're thinking about getting a pool, definitely give them a call—you won't regret it!

Donna has done an outstanding job taking care of me and my family throughout this process. We’ve been researching pools for over five years, and ultimately chose a Thursday Pool because of its exceptional longevity warranty and the high-quality resin gel coat. We couldn’t be happier with our purchase and the experience!

Very impressed with the install team! Our pool was in the ground in just two days, followed by the concrete and electrical work shortly after. The entire process was smooth and efficient. We’re highly impressed with the whole team—thank you!

We had a fantastic experience with TXPools! Donna was amazing—professional, helpful, and always on top of things. She made the whole process easy and stress-free. Our new pool looks incredible, and we couldn't be happier. Highly recommend!

Couldn’t recommend TX Pool enough! They were so great to work with and I loved how quick they are. Donna knew we were on a deadline with our first baby on the way, and was so communicative and helpful throughout the whole process. Thank you TX Pool- we love our new pool and backyard!!

TX Pool built our pool and the entire experience was seamless from start to finish. The team was professional and delivered exactly what we envisioned—if not better. Highly recommend them. Also, Donna was great to work with!

We went with TX pools because they had more options that we didn’t find with other pool companies. Amazing experience with everyone over at TX Pools, highly recommend Donna she is so knowledgeable and quick to answer any question my husband or I had. Excited for our first summer with the new pool, turned out better than we imagined.

TX Pool did a great job building our pool. It looks amazing. They finished it so quickly. They were very professional, efficient, and cleaned up after themselves which I appreciated. I couldn’t be happier with our new pool! No complaints.
Fast, professional, and turned out amazing. Highly recommend for anyone in Texas looking to build a pool.
Love my pool they installed! Their crew was respectful and got the job done quick. Couldn’t be happier, highly recommend!
I’m loving my new pool! Don was great to work with, thoroughly explained everything, and was there anytime I needed him. Would definitely recommend!
I know I want to pull. Just a matter of searching out answers to what I have about fiberglass pools and concrete.
Very professional all around great job
Very good service and good location
